title: Trump Administration Cuts Off Access to a Major Immigration Program for Workers at Microsoft and Adobe
gist: The Trump administration is suspending Microsoft, Adobe, Cognizant, Infosys and Tata from the Labor Department's PERM program, a key step for H-1B holders seeking green cards, over alleged abuse. VP JD Vance singled out Microsoft, which defends its filings, while the administration also investigates nine universities over J-1 visas.

insights.claim: The administration will bar Microsoft, Adobe, Cognizant, Infosys and Tata from PERM, the Labor Department program that lets H-1B holders pursue green cards by showing no suitable American workers exist.
insights.speaker: Kate Taylor
